definition_zh: 传记；传记文学；生平记述
definition_en: an account of a person's life written by someone else
core_image: 一个人的一生被装订成厚厚一册，由他人执笔
scene: 博物馆纪念展旁边开了一家小书店。She spent five years writing the biography of the poet.
sceneCN: 这里 biography 是「传记」（第 1 个义项：他人所写的生平记述）；句意是她花五年为诗人立传。

derivatives.zh: biography 的形容词，义为「传记的；关于生平的」
biography 的缩略，义为「小传；简介」

senses.title: A written life of a person
senses.definition: a book or article telling the story of someone's life, written by another
senses.definitionCN: 由他人执笔、讲述某人生平的书籍或文章
senses.example: She spent five years writing the biography of the poet.
senses.why: Greek bios means life and graphein means to write: the writing of a life.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 bios 意为「生命」，graphein 意为「书写」，合即「书写一生」。

senses.title: Lives as a literary genre
senses.definition: the literary genre of life-writing as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 作为文体的传记写作整体
senses.exampleCN: 传记文学融历史与叙事于一体。
senses.why: One written life stands for all life-writing.
senses.whyCN: 一部传记可代指整个传记文体。

senses.title: The events of a life
senses.definition: the course of a person's life as a set of facts
senses.definitionCN: 作为事实总和的某人一生经历
senses.example: The film sticks closely to the scientist's biography.
senses.exampleCN: 影片紧贴这位科学家的真实生平。
senses.why: The life itself can be called by the word for its record.
senses.whyCN: 一生本身可借其记录之名来称呼。

senses.title: A short life-sketch
senses.definition: a brief account of a life, as in a program or application
senses.definitionCN: 简短生平介绍，如节目册或申请材料中的
senses.example: Each speaker's biography appeared in the program.
senses.exampleCN: 每位讲者的小传都印在手册里。
senses.why: The full book shrinks to a paragraph.

senses.title: Ancient lives tradition
senses.definition: the classical tradition of lives, from Plutarch onward
senses.definitionCN: 自普鲁塔克以降的古典传记传统
senses.example: His essay compares ancient biography with modern.
senses.exampleCN: 他的文章比较古今传记传统。
senses.why: The genre names its own history.
senses.whyCN: 文体之名亦涵盖其自身的历史。

senses.title: A life used for interpretation
senses.definition: a person's life used to explain their work or ideas
senses.definitionCN: 以作者生平解读其作品或思想
senses.example: The critic rejected purely biographical reading.
senses.exampleCN: 这位批评家拒绝纯传记式解读。
senses.why: The life story becomes a critical key.
senses.whyCN: 生平成为解读作品的钥匙。

senses.title: Biography on screen
senses.definition: a filmed or dramatized account of a life
senses.definitionCN: 以影像呈现的生平记述
senses.example: The channel aired a biography of the explorer.
senses.exampleCN: 频道播出了这位探险家的传记纪录片。

senses.title: Collective biographies
senses.definition: works gathering many lives, as national or group biographies
senses.definitionCN: 汇集多人生平的著作，如国家传记辞典
senses.example: The national biography runs to sixty volumes.
senses.exampleCN: 这部国家传记多达六十卷。
senses.why: Many lives bound together keep the same name.
senses.whyCN: 多部小传合订仍沿用此名。

intro.en: Biography joins Greek bios, life, and graphein, to write.
intro.cn: biography 由希腊语 bios「生命」加 graphein「书写」构成。

items.en: gweih₃- meant to live; gwrebh- meant to scratch; reconstructed forms.
items.cn: gweih₃- 意为「活着」；gwrebh- 意为「刻画」（重构形式）。

items.en: bios meant life; graphein meant to write; biographia meant life-writing.
items.cn: 希腊语 bios「生命」、graphein「书写」合成 biographia「为生立传」。

items.en: bios and bioi named the classical genre of lives.
items.cn: 晚期希腊语以 bios 与 bioi 称呼传记文体。

items.en: English biography appears in the 17th century, replacing older word life.
items.cn: 英语 biography 见于 17 世纪，渐代旧词 life。

items.en: now the standard word for life-writing in all media.
items.cn: 如今是各媒介生平书写的标准用语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares bio- or -graphy roots; the near-meaning group gathers life-record words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bio- 或 -graphy 词根；近义组汇集生平记述类词。

entries.definition: the story of one's own life

entries.definitionCN: 参考书目——拼写相近，词根不同

entries.definition: a personal record of events the writer knew
the older English word for a biography
entries.definitionCN: 传——英语旧称，如 the life of Johnson

entries.definition: a short characterization of a person

normalIntro.cn: biography 是 bio-（生命）加 -graphy（书写）。

normal.en: Bio is the common short form.

normal.cn: 普鲁塔克《名人传》塑造了这一文体。

abstract.en: See a whole life bound under one spine.
abstract.cn: 看一生被装订进一个书脊。

abstract.en: Feel the writer borrowing another's years.
abstract.cn: 感受写作者借走他人岁月。

abstract.en: Picture birth and death as bookends.
abstract.cn: 想象生与死是书立的两端。

examples.en: She spent five years writing the biography of the poet.
Each speaker's biography appeared in the program.
examples.cn: 每位讲者的小传都印在手册里。

examples.en: The film sticks closely to the scientist's biography.
examples.cn: 影片紧贴这位科学家的真实生平。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「摆哦·格罗菲」——一生事迹摆成一格一格，落笔成传。

root: 希腊语 bios「生命」（上溯至原始印欧语 gweih₃-「活着」，重构形式）加 graphein「书写」（上溯至 gwrebh-「刻画」，重构形式）；biographia 晚期希腊语已用于称传记文体，17 世纪进入英语，取代旧词 life「传」。

sensesIntro.en: The writing of one life spreads into a genre, a sketch, a reading method, and the life itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 「书写一生」扩展为文体、小传、解读法乃至生平本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: another hand tracing one life from first page to last
core.cn: 核心意象：他人之手描摹一个人从首页到末页的一生

branches.en: The written record, long or short

intro.en: Biography is a Greek life-plus-writing compound.
intro.cn: biography 是希腊语「生命加书写」的复合词。

latinIntro.en: The bio- and -graphy families in Greek and English.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 bio- 与 -graphy 词族。
